Ticket Price: $20 Start Date: 9/3/2024

rules.text:
HOW TO PLAY
MULTIPLIER MANIA PROGRESSIVE
Step 1,
Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer and tell the cashier you’d like to purchase a Multiplier Mania Progressive ticket. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

Step 2,
How to Play

Match any of YOUR NUMBERS to any of the WINNING NUMBERS, multiply the PRIZE shown directly below that number by the MULTIPLIER BONUS amount shown for that ROW. Each ROW is played separately. MULTIPLIER BONUS feature does not apply to progressive jackpot.

Step 3,
Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

faq.text:
How long do I have to claim a prize?

For Fast Play tickets, you have 180 days from the date of purchase to claim your prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

Prizes subject to prior sales. Tampering with a Lottery ticket is a Class 3 felony punishable by law. All tickets, transactions and winners are subject to Lottery Rules and State Law. You must be 21 years or older to purchase tickets.

Are there any limits on Fast Play purchases?

Yes. The bulk purchase of Fast Play tickets is prohibited under the official game rules. Any winning ticket purchased as part of a bulk ticket transaction will not be awarded a prize. For the complete, specific rules on bulk ticket transactions, please visit the Arizona Lottery’s Game Rules and Prohibition page.
